title: One 1 s candidate-fence wait in the removed-reader test can still fail on a slow host
outcome: The candidate-fence loop in source_root_authority_removed_reader_requires_a_durable_pre_io_guard only detects a hang, like the loop before it.
acceptance: The loop at about src/tests/engram_root_authority.rs:2046 uses the same long hang bound as the widened one at line 2008, with a stated reason in place of a failing run or a recorded failing run
